 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Oregon high school football playoffs have arrived, and the Eugene-Springfield area is well represented in the postseason brackets.
 Friday night, No. 5 Sheldon hosts No. 12 Lakeridge in a 6A first-round game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Sheldon (7-2) earned its seed and a home game with last week's 30-27 win against rival Willamette. Lakeridge (5-4) has lost three of its last four games, including a 41-14 defeat at Lake Oswego in the regular-season finale.
 The Register-Guard will have live updates, highlights, photos, videos and postgame coverage from Lakeridge at Sheldon plus playoff scores from around the state. Come back to follow along.
